_comment: Event-name -> the (later) name the same company holds in the replay state. Each entry is a rename or label drift adjudication with the why. Applied via normalised match in ftse250_curate.NameMatcher.
_Shawbrook: 2025 re-IPO of Shawbrook Group plc; Wikipedia anchor labels it 'Shawbrook Bank' (ticker SHAW).
_Utilco: FTSE PDF typo 'Utilco' Dec 2025; Utilico Emerging Markets Trust plc.
_AEP: Anglo-Eastern Plantations renamed AEP Plantations (ticker AEP unchanged).
_InvescoAsia: Invesco Asia Trust renamed Invesco Asia Dragon Trust after Feb 2025 combination with Asia Dragon Trust (the PDF's own 18-Feb-25 row).
_Abrdn: abrdn plc renamed Aberdeen Group plc in 2025.
_JPMIndia: JPMorgan Indian Investment Trust renamed JPMorgan India Growth & Income; the June 2026 review deletion uses the new name.
_RMG: Royal Mail plc renamed International Distributions Services plc October 2022; the 07-May-25 deletion row uses the new name. Same security throughout.
_BGEO: Bank of Georgia Group plc renamed Lion Finance Group plc in 2025.
_BGEOHold: Bank of Georgia Holdings plc renamed Bank of Georgia Group plc in 2018.
_JLEN: JLEN Environmental Assets renamed Foresight Environmental Infrastructure 2024.
_SLPE: Standard Life Private Equity Trust -> abrdn Private Equity Opportunities -> Patria Private Equity Trust; June 2024 name in state.
_SDCL: SDCL Energy Efficiency Income Trust renamed SDCL Efficiency Income Trust 2024 (wiki label).
_Draper: Draper Esprit renamed Molten Ventures November 2021.
_Redde: Redde Northgate renamed ZIGUP plc May 2024 (wiki ticker ZIG).
_JPMEuro: JPMorgan European Smaller Companies Trust renamed JPMorgan European Discovery Trust 2021.
_DGOC: Diversified Gas & Oil renamed Diversified Energy Company May 2021.
_BBH: BB Healthcare Trust renamed Bellevue Healthcare Trust 2021.
_Avon: Avon Rubber renamed Avon Protection 2021 (later Avon Technologies; the 2021-09-20 deletion row uses 'Avon Protection').
_FCGlobal: F&C Global Smaller Companies -> BMO Global Smaller Companies -> The Global Smaller Companies Trust (wiki label).
_JupEuro: Jupiter European Opportunities Trust renamed European Opportunities Trust 2019.
_Countryside: Countryside Properties renamed Countryside Partnerships 2022 (deleted on Vistry merger under the new name).
_CYBG: CYBG plc renamed Virgin Money UK plc October 2019.
_Frasers: Sports Direct International renamed Frasers Group December 2019 (the FTSE 100 master merges this rename; same security).
_Polypipe: Polypipe Group renamed Genuit Group April 2021.
_OSB: OneSavings Bank renamed OSB Group 2020 (post CCFS combination).
_AutoTrader_note: PLACEHOLDER kept only if replay still fails; Auto Trader promoted to FTSE 100; see trail checker.
_JustRetirement: Just Retirement renamed Just Group 2017 after JRP merger.
_Carphone: Carphone Warehouse merged with Dixons Retail August 2014 forming Dixons Carphone; deletion row 2014-09-22 uses 'Dixons Carphone'.
_UDG: United Drug plc renamed UDG Healthcare 2013.
_ICAP: CORRECTED: ICAP plc's retained electronic business renamed NEX Group December 2016 (acquired by CME November 2018); the Tullett Prebon-acquired voice business became TP ICAP, a DIFFERENT company.
_Cairn: Cairn Energy renamed Capricorn Energy December 2021.
_Alliance: Alliance Trust renamed Alliance Witan October 2024 (also merged in the FTSE 100 master's rename chain).
_LondonMetric: London & Stamford merged with Metric Property Investments January 2013 forming LondonMetric Property.
_Brewin: FTSE PDF typo in a later row ('Brewer Dophin'); both refer to Brewin Dolphin Holdings.
_JPMRussian: Abbreviated form in a later PDF row; JPMorgan Russian Securities plc (later JPMorgan Emerging Europe, Middle East & Africa).
_Yule: Yule Catto & Co renamed Synthomer July 2012.
_Genesis: Genesis Emerging Markets Fund: management moved to Fidelity 2021, renamed Fidelity Emerging Markets Limited (wiki FEML).
_Paragon: The Paragon Group of Companies renamed Paragon Banking Group 2017.
_FCIT: Foreign & Colonial Investment Trust renamed F&C Investment Trust 2018 (normalised 'f and c investment trust' in state).
_Galiform: Galiform plc renamed Howden Joinery Group 2010.
_Homeserve: Case-only difference across rows; same company (acquired by Brookfield 2023).
_Hipgnosis_note: C-share line; conversion handled by a corrections entry, not an alias.
_BAG: Inverted name form; A.G. Barr plc (wiki label).
_ESCT: Label drift; The European Smaller Companies Trust.
_AMEC: AMEC renamed Amec Foster Wheeler November 2014 after the Foster Wheeler acquisition.
_CEY: Centamin Egypt renamed Centamin 2011; deleted 2024 (AngloGold acquisition) under the short name.
_POG: Peter Hambro Mining renamed Petropavlovsk September 2009.

_ABG: African Barrick Gold renamed Acacia Mining November 2014; exited 2019 on the Barrick merger under the new name.
_AlNoor: Al Noor Hospitals combined with Mediclinic (reverse takeover) Feb 2016; the listed line continued as Mediclinic International.
_ZPG: Zoopla Property Group renamed ZPG plc 2017; deleted July 2018 (Silver Lake) as ZPG.
_RDI: Redefine International renamed RDI REIT December 2017.
_Currys: Dixons Carphone renamed Currys plc 2021 (wiki CURY).
_Capco: Capital & Counties Properties merged with Shaftesbury March 2023; the enlarged company renamed Shaftesbury Capital (Capco was the surviving issuer).
_PFG: Provident Financial renamed Vanquis Banking Group March 2023; the Sept 2023 deletion row uses the new name.
_Babcock_note: No alias needed once suffix stripping lands; kept as documentation.
_BHMacro_EUR: Currency share-class label; single BH Macro entity in the anchor.
_MicroFocus: Deletion rows abbreviate to 'Micro Focus' (OpenText acquisition 2023).
_UBM: UBM plc full name; deleted rows use the long form.
_MRW: Wiki label vs official name; Wm Morrison Supermarkets (acquired by CD&R Oct 2021).

_MGAM: Morgan Crucible renamed Morgan Advanced Materials March 2013.
_MCG: National Express renamed Mobico Group June 2023.

_BMOGSC: F&C Global Smaller Companies renamed BMO Global Smaller Companies 2019; later The Global Smaller Companies Trust (existing alias closes the chain).
_HWDN: Label variants of Howden Joinery Group.
_WPS: W.A.G payment solutions trades as Eurowag (wiki label).
_IWG_new: IWG plc renamed International Workplace Group (wiki label 2026).
_IWG: Regus renamed IWG 2016; chain Regus->IWG->International Workplace Group.
_VTY: Bovis Homes renamed Vistry Group January 2020.
_Frasers2: Chain closure: wiki-era 'Frasers Group' and snapshot-era 'Sports Direct' join the existing Sports Direct International chain.
British Empire Trust: British Empire Securities and General Trust
_BTEM: Short vs long form; renamed AVI Global Trust 2019.
AVI Global Trust: British Empire Securities and General Trust
_AGT: British Empire Securities & General Trust renamed AVI Global Trust May 2019.

_CCL: Wiki article title 'Carnival Corporation & plc' truncated by extraction; same Carnival plc LSE line.

_FEV: Fidelity European Values renamed Fidelity European Trust 2020.
_APEO: Chain: SLPET -> abrdn PEO -> Patria PET.
_JDW: Wiki label vs official J D Wetherspoon.
